rows.note: Use this as the everyday degree adverb for wanting or needing something very much.

example.english: I badly want to eat roast meat.
example.jyutping: ngo5 hou2 soeng2 sik6 siu1 mei6

rows.note: Use this all-purpose pattern when an action is done badly or not well.

example.jyutping: ngo5 coeng3 go1 coeng3 dak1 m4 hou2
